official_contract.location: MTPBlock and Transformer, source lines approximately739-794 (web display932-987)
official_contract.summary: MTP consumes the four-stream target residual plus shifted token embedding. It separately normalizes and projects both inputs, sums them, applies its own SWA/MoE mHC block, then its own mHC head/norm through shared vocabulary projection. Transformer explicitly shares embed/head with MTP. Official generation example remains ordinary AR and does not establish accept/reject rollback or arbitrary K recursive MTP quality.
official_contract.important: Use residual [T,4,4096] before main mHC-head collapse, not normalized [T,4096], logits, or Kimi feature tap. Exact hidden/token/RoPE offset must be frozen and tested; do not infer Kimi alignment.

minimal_implementation_plan.work: Separate MTP0 NativePredictor: e/h norm + channelINT8 projection + addition/broadcast to4 streams + existing ratio0 SWA/FFN block with mtp.0 checkpoint names. Reuse main embedding and vocabulary matrix by reference, but bind MTP-specific mHC head and norm. Never reuse whole main TextHead with wrong mHC parameters. Relax layer identity only in explicit predictor role; keep primary43 checks.

One MTP proposal from last committed target residual and current target-generated anchor; target verifies packed [anchor,proposal] in one forward with both logits/residuals. Compare proposal against current target distribution/argmax at preceding verification position, not historical AR output. MTP cache must catch up using accepted tokens and target residuals, including an accepted proposal skipped by the next target cycle. Do not recursively feed MTP residual as target hidden to manufacture K>1 coverage.

A diagnostic checkpoint/restore + accepted-input replay can establish state correctness but adds target calls and is not a speed solution. Snapshot owner-specific row rings and host validity masks, compressor active/ring states, compressed/index cache valid ranges, lengths at every level, revisions, poison and accepted selection metadata. Support independent rows. Replaying full history after every rejection is not deployable amortization.

Retain each layer's tentative KV and compressor/indexer projected inputs until acceptance is known. Commit only anchor+accepted proposal input prefix; retain only completed compression groups floor((past+committed_inputs)/ratio), rebuild partial compressor state for accepted prefix from retained projections, and atomically set every layer/wrapper length. Discard rejected future entries and stale pending transactions. MTP state needs the same committed-prefix alignment. This requires new implementation; no existing native API expresses it.

Only after K1 native correctness and positive cycle cost: explicitly evaluate recursiveMTP training/hidden semantics and acceptance for K2+. A single nextn layer does not by itself establish valid inexpensive multi-step draft generation. Kimi DFlash and KDA rollback are different architecture/state and cannot be copied as proof.

acceptance.stage1_CPU_contract: State machine oracle with mixed lengths and explicit rejection at0/first/last/all; boundaries3/4/5,127/128/129 and compression/topk switch; duplicate/foreign/stale pending; row reuse/reset/cancel/error and EOS/cap handling. Zero/partial/all acceptance must produce identical committed-prefix state lifecycle, not identical historic output tokens.
acceptance.stage2_native_reasonable: First actual nextn payload schema/finiteness and native module load/forward qualification, then true2position target verification and actual rollback/continue on all8 owner threads. Cover genuine rejected proposals. Finite logits, reasonable answers, correct arithmetic/QA, no out-of-bounds/state corruption. No GPU F64. No historical full sequence identity gate.
acceptance.stage3_quality: Paired frozen GSM8K and MMLU/Chinese knowledge with same template/precision/sampling/budget;32 random only screening, expand and report paired task-score deltas/intervals, parsing/caps/EOS/coverage. Distinguish exact greedy/current-target verification, corrected distribution sampling, and explicitly approximate acceptance. No small-N nondrop claim.
acceptance.stage4_speed: Same-load AR/MTP paired ordering and same workload; actual draft/verify/accept/rollback/commit/replay/emit wall; accepted tokens per cycle and target forward calls per emitted useful token, discarded work; per-request(n-1)/(last-first), TTFT, ITL P95/P99, total/8cards and >15TPS goodput. Rejections and unfinished requests remain visible. Warmup/draft loading/memory reported.

performance_judgement.can_reduce_target_calls: Yes algorithmically after new allposition+prefix-state implementation; current ac937 CAPI cannot do it.
performance_judgement.condition: For K1 one anchor plus one proposal: average emitted tokens/cycle <=1+acceptance (<=2); useful speed requires totalcyclecost < (1+acceptance)*pairedARstepcost, including MTP catchup and rollback. More FLOPs in a packed verify can reduce call/launch/weight-read overhead, but no wall gain is measured.
performance_judgement.limit: At the observed C4 approximately2.97TPS, even an optimistic 2x ideal gives approximately5.94TPS; that is a conceptual same-regime ceiling for K1, not a forecast. >15TPS needs >5.05x and cannot be promised by this K1 plan. Wider trained/effective speculation or other decode improvements are needed.
performance_judgement.DO_NOT: Do not claim existing64QA qualifies newMTP; do not force all acceptance; do not multiply component speed by43; do not convert B32 aggregate to single-user rate.
